entities.summary: Peter Charanis, born Panagiotis Charanis, was a Greek-born American scholar of Byzantium and the Voorhees Professor of History at Rutgers University. Charanis was long associated with the Dumbarton Oaks research library. Panagiotis Charanis was a journalists & chroniclers from Lemnos (1908, Lemnos–1985-03-23). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
